name: all fours squad stretch
interpretation: Anatomical LEFT all-fours quadriceps stretch. Enter by extending the left hip and bending the knee; the left hand approaches outside the thigh and lightly holds the ankle. The right palm, knee and resting foot support the body while the torso remains neutral and pelvis level. Mirror the entire action and highlights for the other side. The five-second demonstration uses2sentry/1shold/2sreturn; retain the source20–30second workout hold separately.

The left hand loosely holds the left ankle and draws the foot toward the gluteal region. A restrained level-pelvis lower is authored; no straight-and-bent knee is depicted.

source.description: On all fours you pull one foot toward your glutes to stretch the front of the thigh. It eases tight quads.
instructions: Start on all fours with your hands directly under your shoulders and your knees directly under your hips.
Extend one leg straight back, keeping your knee bent and your foot flexed.
Slowly lower your hips towards the ground, feeling a stretch in your quads.
Switch legs and repeat the stretch on the other side.
